title: Validator transition delay can lead to boosted token mismanagement
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `setValidator` function in `Staker.sol` contains a vulnerability related to the management of boosted tokens through the `rewardCache.dropBoost` function call.
